about.title: WELCOME TO SAUDI ARENA
about.subtitle: A digital destination celebrating the energy, talent, and ambition of Saudi esports.
about.story_text: Saudi Arena is a digital platform designed to showcase the exciting world of Saudi esports. We bring tournaments, teams, players, games, and achievements together in one place, making competitive gaming easier to discover and explore.

values.title: OUR MISSION
values.description: To create an engaging destination where esports fans can explore Saudi gaming competitions, discover teams, and celebrate competitive talent.

values.title: OUR VISION
values.description: To inspire greater interest in esports and highlight the growing opportunities within Saudi Arabia's competitive gaming community.

values.title: OUR PASSION
values.description: We believe gaming connects people through competition, teamwork, creativity, and unforgettable moments.
